title: ResourceQueueRepository
responsibility: Persists leases and telemetry and applies reservation decisions atomically across native processes.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Filesystem directory containing this queue SQLite database and validated reserve configuration.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.add.job
inputs.description: One lease with its owner PID, start identity, reservation and heartbeat.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch.id
inputs.description: Lease UUID whose job or heartbeat is read or updated.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch.changes
inputs.description: Partial fields to update atomically on the identified lease.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.remove.id
inputs.description: Lease UUID whose job or heartbeat is read or updated.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.now
inputs.description: Current epoch time in milliseconds for telemetry freshness, queue ordering or lease expiry.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.saveSnapshot.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.all
outputs.description: Persisted leases in insertion order, validated from their stored records.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.add
outputs.description: Inserts the lease using the shared sequence allocator.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch
outputs.description: Atomically updates the matching lease when it still exists.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule
outputs.description: Updated leases after one atomic priority and capacity decision.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.snapshot
outputs.description: Latest timestamped host observation, absent before the first sample.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.saveSnapshot
outputs.description: Persists fresh telemetry without pinning a future cached clock value.
